text: Hello po, I'm the lola of a 3 year old boy, so tired na ako, his parents work nights. Temp is 37.9 I think, the thermometer is a bit old. His eye is pink and sticky, may muta na lumalabas, I keep wiping it. He says his throat is sore but he is still drinking his water and juice, okay naman. Breathing is normal, I checked, no hirap huminga. No rash at all, I looked all over his body. Not sure if I'm worrying for nothing, pero I just want to know if the eye needs something tonight or kaya pa bukas.
